title: Courtyard Tiles
flavor_text: Every clue owns one row, but the marked diagonal owns the message.
content: Arrange four supplied row tokens so all constraints hold: GA begins the plant row, RD touches both GA and EN, DE cannot be first, and EN closes the chain. After satisfying adjacency, read the marked sequence GA-RD-DE-EN and remove the repeated boundary letters according to the tile rule.
